native.qualification: All exact common success margins agree across pinned v1.5.7 normal/sanitized native scanning and safe/cursor/all Rust component probes. Seventeen native window-cap rejections differ from the existing Rust structural header policy and are explicitly enumerated; no full parity claim. Error numeric codes and semantic decode validity are not equated. Includes all96 already-attributed generated decodecorpus frames; this is not an in-place decode or complete upstream-fuzzer assertion.

content_size_extremes.qualification: Forty actual 64-bit content-size boundary observations across two native and three Rust runs. Four native rejections correspond exactly to the native ZSTD_CONTENTSIZE_ERROR sentinel value2^64-2; Rust treats that advertised size as structural metadata. No content-decode or full native parity claim.

platform.qualification: Standalone margin component: four actual strict-provenance Miri runs of12tests on i686/s390x safe/all, two thumbv6m core+alloc checks and two concrete LLVM IR/ARM object builds. Interpretation and code generation, not native foreign hardware execution or an integrated in-place decoder.
